global_pit_constraints: Every rolling price or outcome feature must be shifted by at least one completed exchange session.
feature_source_max_date and candidate_price_source_max_date must be strictly before the target date.
Current target-date actual open, high, low, close and actual overnight return are forbidden.
Current TDnet data are allowed only when their source timestamp is at or before 08:58:59 JST and tdnet_source_complete is true.
Missing source coverage must never be encoded as no event.
Training, preprocessing, calibration, grouping thresholds and uncertainty estimates must use dates strictly before the score date.
All train/test splits must be by exchange date, never by row.

hypotheses.title: TSE asymmetric large-loss rebound
hypotheses.novelty_vs_existing: Replaces the existing symmetric linear cc_reversal_1_atr treatment with separately identified negative and positive hinges and a market-residual negative shock.
hypotheses.falsification: Reject if negative hinges do not improve fixed-period net20 over the symmetric linear control, if positive and negative shocks are economically symmetric, or if the sign fails across fixed time blocks.
pit_constraints: Use only the immediately prior completed close-to-close return and prior market return.
Do not construct the shock from the target session open.

hypotheses.title: Weekly intraday inventory reversal conditioned on friction and market volatility
hypotheses.novelty_vs_existing: Uses past OC rather than close-to-close return and imposes the Japan-specific reversal interaction with lagged activity friction and market volatility.
hypotheses.falsification: Reject if the reversal sign is absent, if the interaction signs do not repeat in fixed blocks, or if tail-removed net20 fails to improve.
pit_constraints: All five OC observations must be completed before the target date.
No-trade rows are excluded from return means and are retained only in the explicit friction proxy.

hypotheses.title: Joint overnight-day tug-of-war state
hypotheses.novelty_vs_existing: Models the joint sign path on the same historical session rather than relying on separate overnight and OC means or their linear correlation.
hypotheses.falsification: Reject if joint rates add no fixed-period net20 beyond separate oc_mean and overnight_mean controls or if their signs reverse between periods.
pit_constraints: Build each joint pair only after both prior-session overnight and OC are observed.
Shift the rolling statistic one complete exchange session.
Exclude nontrades and incomplete source rows from both numerator and denominator.

hypotheses.title: Retail-attention opening overpricing proxy
hypotheses.novelty_vs_existing: Creates an asymmetric positive-overnight attention state multiplied by valuation/arbitrage-difficulty proxies; the prior gap-response group did not encode this mechanism.
hypotheses.falsification: Reject if the high-pressure group does not reverse intraday, if the effect is equally strong in low-friction stocks, or if it adds nothing beyond overnight_mean.
pit_constraints: overnight_last is the prior completed session's gap, not the target-date gap.
Do not label activity proxies as measured spreads or turnover.

hypotheses.title: Day-only horizon-separated reversal and momentum
hypotheses.novelty_vs_existing: Uses literature-aligned nonoverlapping short-reversal and twelve-month-minus-one-month momentum windows and a same-window overnight placebo instead of allowing a pooled model to mix horizons and sessions.
hypotheses.falsification: Reject if the day-only specification does not beat an equal-capacity day-plus-night control, if day momentum is unstable, or if it is indistinguishable from the overnight placebo.
pit_constraints: Fix 20, 252 and skip-20 windows before reading results.
Use completed OC and overnight observations only.
Rows with fewer than 252 complete prior sessions are missing for this hypothesis and must not be filled with zero.

hypotheses.title: Marketwide TDnet distraction interacted with event direction
hypotheses.novelty_vs_existing: Counts the contemporaneous marketwide information load rather than only the focal firm's document and family counts.
hypotheses.falsification: Reject if supportive events do not show stronger OC continuation on congested days, if the effect appears equally among non-event stocks, or if source-complete fixed blocks disagree.
pit_constraints: Aggregate only records available by 08:58:59 JST.
Require complete TDnet coverage for the whole date before computing the market count.
Do not encode an incomplete date as zero congestion.
hypotheses.coverage_limitation: Evaluate only dates on which the repository proves complete TDnet coverage.

hypotheses.title: Friday-disclosure and post-long-holiday directional disclosure drift
hypotheses.novelty_vs_existing: Tests event direction against the actual source-disclosure weekday and elapsed holiday interval, not a generic target-day weekday sine/cosine feature.
hypotheses.falsification: Reject if the effect is also present in no-event stocks, has no direction asymmetry, or disappears outside one calendar month.
pit_constraints: Calendar features must be known before open.
Use only cutoff-safe disclosure features and a frozen exchange calendar.

hypotheses.title: Corroborated directional disclosure bundle
hypotheses.novelty_vs_existing: Separates same-direction economic corroboration from raw family count and generic support-adverse conflict.
hypotheses.falsification: Reject if positive corroboration does not beat isolated positive events after controlling for document count or if conflict is indistinguishable.
pit_constraints: All component disclosures must be in the same cutoff-safe bundle.
Direction-unknown titles remain unknown and cannot be imputed as supportive.

hypotheses.title: Point-in-time earnings-wave sequence
hypotheses.novelty_vs_existing: Uses the point-in-time position within the market earnings wave rather than a fixed month or generic event flag.
hypotheses.falsification: Reject if early-versus-late differences disappear after event direction and month controls, or if signs fail across earnings waves.
pit_constraints: Never divide by the final number of announcements in the current future-completed wave.
Use only an expanding estimate based on prior completed waves.
Require complete TDnet coverage.
hypotheses.coverage_limitation: TDnet source-complete dates and enough prior completed waves are required.

hypotheses.title: Top-heavy listwise net-gain ranker
hypotheses.novelty_vs_existing: Directly optimizes each date's top one or two net gains; the existing pairwise model samples broad pairs and the Ridge target treats the whole daily rank nearly uniformly.

predicted_sign.objective_effect: higher scheduled-day top1 and top2 net20 than pointwise Ridge and uniform pairwise rank

hypotheses.falsification: Reject if no fixed untouched retrospective block improves top2 net20, tail-removed net20 and monthly stability versus both daily-rank Ridge and pairwise linear rank.
pit_constraints: The query label and gain exist only for training dates.
Fit preprocessing and ranker on dates strictly before each score month.
Never sample train and score rows from the same date.

hypotheses.title: Opening-noise group-specific experts
hypotheses.novelty_vs_existing: Fits separate models for economically heterogeneous opening-noise and ordinary groups rather than adding another global interaction term.
hypotheses.falsification: Reject if group coefficient differences do not repeat, if the global model wins, or if gains depend on one sparse group or a few codes.
pit_constraints: Estimate group cutoffs inside each training fold.
Assign score rows with only their lagged features.
Use identical base feature count and regularization policy in both experts.

hypotheses.title: Two-part distributional net-value decision
hypotheses.novelty_vs_existing: Separates the probability of clearing cost from positive and negative conditional magnitudes and adds a training-only uncertainty penalty; this differs from the existing fixed-threshold ordinal integration.

predicted_sign.objective_effect: higher top1 and top2 net return after 20 and 40bp

hypotheses.falsification: Reject if conditional magnitude calibration fails across blocks, if 20bp gains disappear at 40bp, or if sign-logit and daily-rank Ridge remain superior.
pit_constraints: Fit all three conditional models and calibration bins using training dates only.
Compute residual MAD expanding through the prior date only.
Keep the daily top two display separate from the optional net_value<=0 cash decision.
